message.content:
Based on my search, "Glenwood Pool" can refer to several different pools. Here are the main ones:

## Glenwood Hot Springs Pool (Colorado)

The most famous "Glenwood Pool" is the **Glenwood Hot Springs Pool** in Glenwood Springs, Colorado — the **world's largest outdoor mineral hot springs pool**.

**Key Facts:**
- **Established:** 1888
- **Water source:** Yampah Spring (produces 3.5 million gallons/day at 122°F)
- **Grand Pool:** 405 ft long × 100 ft wide (123 × 30 meters), containing **1,071,000 gallons** of water at 90°–93°F (32°–34°C)
- **Therapy Pool:** 100 ft × 40 ft, containing 91,000 gallons at 104°F (40°C)
- **Features:** Diving board, 4 lap lanes, Sopris Splash Zone (added in 2019 with water slides, splash pad, and children's area)
- **2024 Updates:** Added 5 new pools including a cold plunge (52°–60°F), infinity pool, and two waterfall pools

**Admission:** $27–$55 depending on age and season; open daily 8 a.m. to 10 p.m., year-round

---

## Glenwood Houses Swimming Pool (Brooklyn, NYC)

A free public **mini pool** located in **Glenwood Playground** at Farragut Road & Ralph Avenue in East Flatbush, Brooklyn.

- **Dimensions:** 40' × 20' × 3'
- **Hours:** 11 a.m. – 7 p.m. daily (cleaning break 3–4 p.m.)
- **Phone:** 718.531.2480
- Open to adults only when accompanied by a child

---

## Glenwood Park Pool (Columbus, Ohio)

A community pool located in **Glenwood Park**, a 16.72-acre park in the Greater Hilltop area.

- **Park amenities:** Basketball courts, community center, community garden, playground, pool, paved paths, woods and wildlife area
- **Note:** Parking lot was being resurfaced as of the latest update (restricted access 7 a.m.–4 p.m.)

---

## Glenwood Aquatic Center (Glenwood, Iowa)

A municipal aquatic facility featuring:
- **Activity Pool:** 28,000 gallons, zero-depth entry, geysers, spray features, water slide
- **Lap Pool:** 277,000 gallons, 8 lanes, 25-meter, 1-meter diving board, 4–12 ft deep, 82°–84°F
- **Hot Tub:** 2,000 gallons, ages 14+, 104°–105°F

---

If you were asking about a specific Glenwood Pool, please let me know which location you're interested in, and I can provide more details!

---

Sources:
1. https://hotspringspool.com/press-room/press-kit/fact-sheet-glenwood-hot-springs/
2. https://visitglenwood.com/things-to-do/glenwood-hot-springs/
3. https://www.glenwoodrec.com/166/Aquatic-Center
4. https://www.brooklynblvd.nyc/article/180/brooklyn-outdoor-free-public-swimming-pools-in-bk-nyc
5. https://hanginglake.com/hot-springs/glenwood-hot-springs-pool/
6. https://www.findinghotsprings.com/mag/glenwood-hot-springs
7. https://letsjetkids.com/glenwood-hot-springs-with-kids/
8. https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g33446-d116241-Reviews-Glenwood_Hot_Springs_Pool-Glenwood_Springs_Colorado.html
9. https://columbusrecparks.com/parks/glenwood-park/
10. https://www.nycgovparks.org/parks/glenwood-playground/facilities/outdoor-pools
